title: SQL Injection - Administrator Authentication Bypass
impact: Authentication bypass allowing unauthorized access to the administrator account and privileged application functions.
remediation: Use parameterized SQL queries and prepared statements. Implement secure authentication and server-side authorization checks.

title: SQL Injection - Product Search Injection Attempt
payload_used: qwert')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9' FROM Users--
impact: Attempted UNION-based SQL injection targeting the Users table to retrieve user identifiers, email addresses, and password hashes. Successful extraction was not confirmed during testing.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements. Validate user input and enforce least-privilege database access.

title: Cross-Site Scripting - JavaScript Injection
impact: Successful execution of injected JavaScript in the browser, demonstrating that untrusted input can be interpreted as executable HTML or JavaScript.
remediation: Implement context-aware output encoding, sanitize untrusted HTML, and avoid unsafe DOM manipulation methods.

title: Cross-Site Scripting - Bonus Payload HTML Injection
impact: Successful injection of an external iframe through the vulnerable input, demonstrating insufficient handling of user-controlled HTML content.
remediation: Sanitize user-generated HTML, enforce a strict Content Security Policy, validate permitted iframe sources, and use safe DOM rendering methods.
